entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to return something and I expect this to be handled now!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. I hear you're looking to make a return; I can certainly help with that.
You better. I bought this helmet and I want my money back. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The issue is the color! It looks nothing like it did online. It's hideous. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging, the box is still unopened. I just want to send it back.

I'm very sorry to hear the color wasn't what you expected. Your safety and satisfaction are important to us. Let me just pull up your order to check the return details. Do you have your order number handy?

It's VF88602. And you better not give me any runaround. I've had this thing for almost a month, and if this isn't simple, I'll be speaking to your manager and letting everyone know on social media how you operate.
Thank you for that number, one moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered on December 20th, which was 29 days ago. Let me just consult our policy.
There shouldn't be anything to consult. Just take it back.

You're absolutely right. I've confirmed that your helmet is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can process that for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label. There will be no charge.
Oh. Really? A prepaid label? So I don't have to pay for shipping?

That's correct. Since the box is unopened and it's within the policy, the return shipping is on us. You should see that email in the next five minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Okay. Well... that's... good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
